triage.reason: Substantive description and access; at least two additional supported evidence dimensions.

research_venue.Name: City's Istanbul Mall
research_venue.Description: City's Istanbul is an operating shopping mall at İçerenköy, Kayışdağı Cd No 2/2, Ataşehir, near Kozyatağı metro. It is distinct from CITY'S Nişantaşı. Original directory has Apr 12 2026 visitor-sounding assessment calling it good but warning about cleaning and security, and Apr 18 floor-specific Q/A 's1 and s3'. These show contemporary user knowledge but DO NOT confirm physical encounters, restroom entry permission, or visitor safety. Operator lists mall hours 10:00–22:00 and car park 08:00–22:00, not toilet hours.

triage.reason: Substantive description and access; at least two additional supported evidence dimensions.

research_venue.Name: Wc Unirii
research_venue.Description: Gays-Cruising names a purported restroom by the Unirii metro area; Metrorex confirms public toilet facilities at Piața Unirii 1. Historical comments conflict: 2024 and March 2025 say reported fixtures were closed/covered; a first-person July 2025 commenter reports cruising, but before the 2025-11-06 cutoff. The 2026-04-08 comment asks whether anyone is around in 30 minutes. A 2026 query is not a sighting, and toilet access for lawful adult activity is not established.

triage.name: Metrou Piata Victoriei
triage.reason: Substantive description and access; at least two additional supported evidence dimensions.

research_venue.Name: Metrou Piata Victoriei
research_venue.Description: Gays-Cruising describes a public toilet at Piața Victoriei metro, confirmed as having passenger restrooms on Metrorex's official list. Reports are notably contradictory: 2025-11-05 commenter describes firsthand sexual activity (one day BEFORE cutoff), 2025-11-17 commenter reports visiting and finding the location empty and a covered fixture, and 2025-11-26 commenter says the physical fixture remains covered yet describes location as active. The latter activity claim has no explicit date of an observed encounter. More recent Feb–Apr 2026 messages are only questions/arrangements; do not treat those as observed activity. Never repeat access/ticket-bypass instructions.
